## Further reading {#sec-further-reading}

For the logical symbols and proof conventions used in these notes
(whose definitions are on the [Proof Writing](proof-writing.qmd#sec-proof-definitions) page):

- @velleman2019prove
  explains how mathematical statements are built from
  logical connectives ([definition](proof-writing.qmd#def-logical-connective)) and quantifiers ([definition](proof-writing.qmd#def-quantifier)),
  and how to read and write them.
- @barkerplummer2011language
  covers the same symbols as a formal language,
  with propositional logic (the logic of connectives)
  and first-order logic (which adds quantifiers).

For set and function notation, see the [Sets](sets.qmd), [Functions](functions.qmd), and [Expressions and Algorithms](expressions-algorithms.qmd) pages.
